## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a5cbb8fc64385836bae72ce41e11418b7e05ad36`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectui/evals/data-integration.json, skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md + packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/database-driver-flag.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/dev-default-db.test.ts, packages/cli/package.json, packages/runtime/src/resolve-project-database.ts, ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts, ui/packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts, ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts, packages/client/src/index.ts, skills/objectui/SKILL.md, skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md, skills/objectui/guides/testing.md, skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md, ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs, scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs, packages/skills/scripts/sync-catalog.mjs

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set: none moves.** No schema, no spec key, no runtime code in the diff. Right.
- **Published surface `@objectstack/skills`** (`packages/skills/scripts/sync-catalog.mjs` copies `skills/**` into its `dist`): § "MSW mock setup (frontend-first development)" becomes § "Frontend-first development"; the two MSW pitfall bullets go; eval 2 is re-graded. Right — `packages/plugins/` on `main` holds no `plugin-msw`, and `git grep 'plugin-msw\|MSWPlugin' -- skills` on the head is 0 hits (card acceptance 1). Nothing else in the tree links the old heading or `startMockServer` (repo-wide grep on the head: only CHANGELOG / RELEASE_NOTES history, one runtime docblock, and `ui/`'s own "there is no plugin-msw" lines).
- **Eval 2 grading** — `must_contain` `os dev` / `proxy` / `objectstack.config`, `must_not_contain` `enableBrowser` / `setupWorker`. Right: every `must_contain` token is a whole token the bundle teaches (the bundle-wide oracle of `ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs`; CI's Lint UI ran it green), and the refusals name the removed plugin's option and MSW's browser worker API — `guides/testing.md:326-330` teaches `setupServer` from `msw/node`, never `setupWorker`, so the bundle's own text cannot trip them. One thinness carried to ④.
- **Token ratchet**: guide 4280 against ceiling 4451, eval 466 against 471 (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs:1175,1202`), ceilings untouched; the shrink is headroom. Right. Card's line-budget acceptance met (net −35 lines).
- **Lane remainder at `TIER_DEFAULT`** (read, not reviewed): `VITE_USE_MOCK_SERVER` has no reader under `ui/` on `main` outside the two env files, `vercel.json`, the telemetry test and a recipe comment in `ui/playwright.import-console.config.ts:24`; `ui/apps/console/public/` holds no `mockServiceWorker.js`; `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts` declares no `vendor-msw` chunk. One note for the lane seat: `committed-telemetry-endpoint.test.ts:118` now asserts `VITE_SERVER_URL` parses to `''`, and both env files carry exactly that one empty assignment, so the "parses real assignments" vacuum guard no longer proves the parser reads a VALUE, only a key — a weaker guard than the `'false'` it replaced. Not a finding of this record.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/27678-objectui-skill-msw-removed.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch, `@object-ui/console` patch; `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body and the changeset body alike. Matches the diff: `@objectstack/skills` ships the changed text; `@object-ui/console` is public, in the fixed group, and `.env.production` is a build input of its published dist — nothing behavioural moves, so patch is the floor, and `skip-changeset` would be wrong for a released package whose content changes.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` is right: nothing an author can write changes. `Clause-②: no` is right: no published accept-set widens or narrows. Not breaking; no ADR-0087 disposition owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev report 6510080703: `open_questions: []` — none owed. Deviations and findings, each answered:

- **Deviation — primary checkout on the platform branch.** Recorded as the card-thread exception in claim 6509324636; acknowledged, nothing for this record.
- **Deviation — `vercel.json` drops the `mockServiceWorker.js` rewrite exclusion.** Right: `ui/apps/console/public/` on `main` holds `favicon.svg`, `logo.svg`, `manifest.json`, `vite.svg` only. Lane seat's file.
- **Deviation — console patch changeset.** Right, see ②.
- **Out-of-scope finding 1 — `ObjectStackAdapter({ baseUrl: '/api/v1' })` doubles the prefix.** Read from source and upgraded from candidate to finding. `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts:3432-3435` builds discovery as `baseUrl + '/api/v1/discovery'` with no suffix strip, while the adapter's own search / data / export / meta paths (`:3765-3769`, `:5162-5167`, `:5294-5298`, `:5463-5467`) do strip a trailing `/api/vN` — the adapter disagrees with itself; the underlying `ObjectStackClient` (`packages/client/src/index.ts:1704`, `:1733`, and every route as `${this.baseUrl}${route}` where discovery's routes are absolute `/api/v1/...` paths) takes an ORIGIN; and every adapter read and write awaits `connect()` first (`:3656`, `:3844`, `:4378`, …). So `baseUrl: '/api/v1'` sends discovery to `/api/v1/api/v1/discovery`, the REST layer answers 404, `connect()` rejects, every call fails. The console passes `VITE_SERVER_URL || ''` (`ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx:105`). The guide on the head carries `baseUrl: '/api/v1'` at `:133`, `:155`, `:218`, `:461` — all on `main` before this PR, none in this diff. **Escalated: a card for `domain:skills` (carrier: seat), with its `ui/**` half (the discovery line against the four suffix-tolerant methods) named in the same card for triage to split.** Not charged to this PR: its scope is the MSW section, and Prime Directive #10 says file, never expand.
- **Out-of-scope finding 2 — #27580 reads as a duplicate.** Triage's; noted.
- **Out-of-scope finding 3 — deprecating `@objectstack/plugin-msw` on npm.** The maintainer's release action, as triage 6504442774 ruled; noted.
- **Dispatch mechanism assumption** ("`objectstack dev` with an in-memory driver") measured false by the dev and confirmed here: `packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts:70-75` (in-memory engine is no longer a boot store), `packages/cli/src/utils/database-driver-flag.ts` (the oclif allowlist derives from `DATABASE_DRIVER_SELECTION_IDS`, from which `memory` has left), `dev-default-db.test.ts:69-94` (pins the resolution refusal). The guide teaches what the tree does. Right.

### ④ Design judgment

**`skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md`** — every claim of the new section read against `main`:

- "No mock-server plugin; removed in 12.0; npm still serves 11.x — do not install": `packages/plugins/` holds no `plugin-msw`; the registry reading is the card's item 4. Holds.
- "No backend: static scope": § "Static data (no backend)" at `:160` with `PredicateScopeProvider`. Holds.
- `os dev` on `http://localhost:3000`, busy port → banner: `packages/cli/package.json` exposes both `os` and `objectstack`; `dev.ts:537` `requestedPort = port ?? '3000'`; `dev.ts:539-570` probes with `getAvailablePort` ahead of the compile and prints `formatDevPortShiftNotice` (`serve.ts:481-490`: "Port N is in use — serving on M instead"). Holds.
- `os dev --fresh` throwaway database, deleted on exit: `dev.ts:706-716` (`mkdtemp` under the OS tempdir, `data/objectstack.db` inside it, `rmSync` on exit), flag text `:394`. Holds; the flag's own caveat (cwd-relative datasource files survive) is the detail the pointer to `objectstack-platform` carries.
- Vite proxy snippet: the same shape as `ui/apps/console/vite.config.ts:1508-1510` (`'/api': { target: DEV_PROXY_TARGET || 'http://localhost:3000', changeOrigin: true }`). Holds.
- "persists to a SQLite file": `dev.ts:66-70` unified default `data/objectstack.db` under the state dir; `dev-default-db.test.ts:38`. Holds as the default.
- "seeds a dev admin `admin@objectos.ai` / `admin123` on an empty database": `dev.ts:396-407` (`--seed-admin` default on, acts only while no login exists); `skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md:11` says the same. Holds.
- "no in-memory driver; `--database-driver memory` is refused": `database-driver-flag.ts` header and allowlist; `dev-default-db.test.ts:69-78`. Holds.
- "`--database :memory:` is SQLite's in-memory database": `dev.ts:367` flag help; `packages/runtime/src/resolve-project-database.ts:104-113`, `:302`. Holds.
- "Commands and flags: the `objectstack-platform` skill": `operations.md:11` (`os dev`, `--seed-admin`, `--fresh`, the credentials), `:63-78` (port resolution); the objectui `SKILL.md` Scope table already defers bootstrap and drivers there. Holds.

Against the card's eval prompt: an agent loading the bundle answers `os dev` plus the `/api` proxy plus the Todo object in `objectstack.config.ts` (`project-setup.md:195`); that is a working local API, and nothing in the bundle leads it to `enableBrowser` or `setupWorker`. Holds.

Findings — none must-fix:

- **should-fix** — the "Real API, locally" bullet never says where the objects come from. The eval's expected answer names `objectstack.config`, and after this diff the only place the whole bundle teaches that token is the heading at `project-setup.md:195`; the eval's own guide no longer says it. One clause ("run `os dev` in the ObjectStack app whose `objectstack.config.ts` declares the object") makes the eval answerable from its own guide; the 171-token headroom covers it.
- **should-fix** — the proxy recipe fits a project that runs Vite itself. `objectui dev` (`ui/packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts:77-94`) builds an inline Vite config with `root: tmpDir`, `server.port` and no proxy, so a project on the `objectui dev` path that `project-setup.md:165-192` also offers cannot apply the `vite.config.ts` snippet as written. Say which dev server the snippet is for, in a clause.
- **nit** — "persists to a SQLite file" is the default; `OS_DATABASE_URL` or a config-declared datasource overrides it (`dev.ts:66-70`). "by default" would be exact.
- The verified `baseUrl: '/api/v1'` defect (③) is the guide's, pre-existing, on four lines outside this diff: carded, not charged here.

**`skills/objectui/evals/data-integration.json`** — the prompt now describes the scenario the tree supports; `expected_output` names the taught path; the `must_contain` tokens are whole tokens the bundle teaches; the `must_not_contain` pair refuses the old answer by its two most distinctive tokens, and neither appears in the bundle's own text. Holds. nit: `os dev` rewards one of the two bin spellings (`objectstack dev` would fail the eval); the guide teaches `os dev`, so an agent following it passes.

**Gates on the head**: 46 check-runs success, 8 skipped, `Test Core (1/8)` still in progress and the aggregate `Test Core` context not yet reported when this record was rendered; every other required context is green (Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Build Core, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint UI, Type Check UI, Test UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI). Landing is Tier H (`skills/**`): the maintainer's approval lands it; this record is the compensating control the claim named, not the landing.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0895780ae213da6ade8c65bbd9fb95f9cf342595`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md + skills/objectui/evals/data-integration.json, skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md, packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/artifact-precedence.ts, ui/packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts, ui/scripts/check-skills-paths.mjs, ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs, scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs

Delta review over record 6510354851 (PASS on `a5cbb8fc64385836bae72ce41e11418b7e05ad36`). One commit on top of that head, one file, +7 −6, `skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md` only; its parent is `a5cbb8fc`, so the net diff against `main` is the reviewed diff plus this delta. Everything 6510354851 judged on the untouched files stands as written; only the delta is judged here.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set: none moves.** Prose only. Right.
- **Published surface `@objectstack/skills`**: the "Real API, locally" bullet and the `os dev` paragraph are reworded; no heading, code block or eval changes. Right.
- **Eval 2's `objectstack.config` token** is now taught in the eval's own guide (`data-integration.md:361`, `objectstack.config.ts` in a code span) as well as `project-setup.md:195`; the bundle-wide oracle of `ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` can only get greener. Right.
- **Gate exposure of the new code span**: `ui/scripts/check-skills-paths.mjs:166` counts a backtick token as a stated path only when it opens with one of `PATH_PREFIXES` followed by `/`; `objectstack.config.ts` and `objectui dev` open with neither, so the paths gate does not read them. Right.
- **Budgets**: guide 479 → 480 lines (514 on `main`, still net −34, card acceptance held); the three edits add on the order of twenty ratchet tokens against the 171-token headroom under ceiling 4451 (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs:1202`, untouched). Right; `Lint · repo & tooling gates` is the gate of record and is still running.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged from 6510354851: the changeset is untouched, its "Now" paragraph describes the section at the level of the two paths and the `os dev` facts, which this delta keeps; `@objectstack/skills` patch, `@object-ui/console` patch, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` still match a prose-only diff.

### ③ Boundary flags

No new dev report on this head; the commit message names the two should-fixes it carries. Each finding of 6510354851, checked against the delta:

- **should-fix 1 (where the objects come from)** — applied: "run `os dev` in the ObjectStack app whose `objectstack.config.ts` declares your objects". Right against the tree: `os dev` resolves `objectstack.config.ts` in its cwd (`packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts:436-437`, flag text `:320` and `:342`, the refusal at `:585` when neither it nor `--artifact` exists; `artifact-precedence.ts:8` ranks the cwd config in the boot order).
- **should-fix 2 (which dev server the proxy is for)** — applied: "In a project that runs Vite itself (not `objectui dev`), proxy `/api` to it". Right against the tree: `ui/packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts:77-94` builds an inline Vite config with `root: tmpDir`, `server.port`, `server.host`, `server.open`, `server.fs.allow` and no `proxy`, so a project on the `objectui dev` path cannot apply a `vite.config.ts` proxy; `objectui dev` is the command `project-setup.md:165-192` teaches, so the name is one the bundle's reader knows.
- **nit ("by default")** — applied: "By default `os dev` persists to a SQLite file…". Right (`dev.ts:66-70`: `--database` / `--fresh`, then the env URLs, then a config-declared datasource, then the unified default file).
- **The escalated `baseUrl: '/api/v1'` card** (6510354851 ③) is unaffected: the four lines are untouched, as intended; still the seat's to file.

### ④ Design judgment

**`skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md`** (the delta's only hit) — the three reworded sentences read against the code they cite (above) and against the card's eval prompt: an agent now finds `os dev`, `objectstack.config.ts`, the `/api` proxy and the Vite-only caveat in one bullet of the eval's own guide, which is the scenario eval 2 grades; the `must_not_contain` pair is untouched. The sentence structure stays one bullet per path; the two code blocks and the `objectstack-platform` pointer are unchanged. Nothing wrong is introduced: no claim in the delta names a flag, path, command or default the tree does not carry. No must-fix, no should-fix, no nit remaining.

**Gates on the head** (read when this record was rendered): 10 check-runs success — among the required set `Governed Surface Queue Guard` and `Live E2E UI` — 8 skipped, 0 failed, 34 still running: `Build Core`, `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, every `Lint ·` and `Type Check ·` lane, `Test Core (1/8)`, `Test Core (2/8)` and all sixteen `Test UI` shards; the aggregate `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core` and `Test UI` contexts are not yet reported. The delta is prose in one governed file, so the gates it can move are the skill gates named in ① (token ratchet, eval tokens, stated paths), each judged green by reading above; the running set is for the landing seat to read to conclusion before the maintainer's approval lands this Tier H PR.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：已发布的 `objectui` 技能不再教 12.0 已删除的 MSW 插件；「前端先行开发」一节改教树上真有的两条路（无后端用静态 scope；或在声明对象的 ObjectStack 应用里跑 `os dev`，自己跑 Vite 的项目把 `/api` 代理过去），eval 2 改判这个答案；同 PR 删掉 console 里没人读的 `VITE_USE_MOCK_SERVER` 等 MSW 残留。
- 为什么改：客户 agent 照抄会装上 npm 上未弃用的 11.0.0 旧插件，混进 18.x 栈；旧 eval 还给这个错答案打满分。
- 风险与回滚：纯技能文本、eval 与 console 构建配置，无运行时行为变化；revert 本 PR 即回滚。技能净减 34 行，token 天花板未动。
- 先看：`skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md` 新「Frontend-first development」一节，`skills/objectui/evals/data-integration.json` 的 eval 2。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -n 'plugin-msw\|MSWPlugin' -- skills` 与 `git grep -n 'VITE_USE_MOCK_SERVER\|vendor-msw' -- ui/apps` 均无输出。
- 需要你做的：受管面 Tier H，请批准本 PR（契约复核 PASS 6510726471，`Head-sha: 0895780ae213da6ade8c65bbd9fb95f9cf342595`）；npm 上是否弃用 `@objectstack/plugin-msw` 是发版动作，另由你定。

席位意见：ACCEPT。契约复核两轮（全量 6510354851 PASS，两条 should-fix 与一处措辞已在 `0895780a` 落实，增量 6510726471 PASS），CI 全绿；批准后由席位落地。

## 席位核对

- **形态:** one PR, `Fixes #27678`, 8 files (+41/−66 at the reviewed head plus the 1-file delta); `skills/objectui/**` net −34 lines, guide 4303 / 4451 tokens, eval 466 / 471; ceilings unmoved. Tier H (`skills/**`); under the 3000-line threshold.
- **前提实测:** `plugin-msw` / `MSWPlugin` present in `skills/` on `origin/main` `481ade61` (guide `:365`, `:375`; eval `:25`, `:31`); the four console remnants present. The dispatch's mechanism assumption (`objectstack dev` with an in-memory driver) was measured false by the dev and confirmed by the review (`packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts:70-75`, `database-driver-flag.ts`); the guide teaches the SQLite default, `--fresh` and `--database :memory:` instead.
- **门禁 check-runs:** head `0895780ae213da6ade8c65bbd9fb95f9cf342595`: 56 check-runs, 48 success, 8 skipped (path-scheduled), 0 failed, 0 pending; Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core, Test UI, Build Core, Lint UI, Type Check UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard green.
- **接受的偏差:** `vercel.json` drops the `mockServiceWorker.js` rewrite exclusion (no such file in `ui/apps/console/public`); `@object-ui/console` patch changeset (`.env.production` is a build input of its dist); `committed-telemetry-endpoint.test.ts` guard re-pointed from `VITE_USE_MOCK_SERVER` to `VITE_SERVER_URL` (the review notes it now proves a key is parsed, not a value; accepted, not a finding).
- **范围外去向:** `ObjectStackAdapter({ baseUrl: '/api/v1' })` doubling discovery → filed #27774; #27580 reads as a duplicate of this card → triage; npm deprecation of `@objectstack/plugin-msw` → the maintainer's release action. `Skills-docs:` n/a (`Metadata-protocol: none`).
- **落地条款:** Tier H: a GOVERNED_APPROVERS approval, then the seat lands (clear label, ready, auto-merge) under the maintainer's landing grant for this term (seat thread, 2026-10-29 22:04Z).
